get.description: Returns all Meeting Categories for a given Meeting.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

items.description: A grouping of meeting topics within a Meeting. Topics (agenda/minutes items) are organized under categories.

id.description: Unique identifier for this meeting category. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to update the category via `/rest/v1.0/meeting_categories/{id}`.

title.description: Display name of the category, shown as a section heading for its topics.

position.description: Zero-based ordering of this category within the Meeting; lower values sort first.

created_by.description: The Project user who created this category. Null when the creator is unknown (for example, on categories created before creator tracking).

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/meeting_categories?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&meeting_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":192424,\"meeting_id\":213513,\"meeting_category\":{\"position\":1,\"title\":\"Uncategorized Items\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/meeting_categories", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
